//: How the rough-ground dev level is generated. Run it with: powershell -File tools/rebuild_level.ps1 -Level rough_ground
notes: gen_rough_ground.gd owns this level end to end and overwrites every byte of it: heightmap,
both splats, the LevelInfo and the .tscn text. Every position (lanes, patches, bump seed,
ditch depths) lives in tools/rough_ground_layout.gd, which tools/measure_rough.gd reads
too, so moving a patch there moves the measurement with it; re-run this chain after any
Unregistered (not in LevelRegistry): F6 it, or drive it through measure_rough. It has no
AuthoringRoot, so there is nothing to bake and no .bake.json.

steps.why: Writes the island heightmap (plateau, lanes' bump fields and V-ditches), both splats (grass/sand, asphalt and mud lanes), the LevelInfo and the level .tscn text.
The terrain reads the fresh PNGs through their imports.
